summary: A delta pane from the futures trade stream: delta bars or cumulative delta candles, with marked divergences.
overview: Delta pane (L1) puts delta in its own pane in one of two styles: delta bars, with strong bars highlighted, or cumulative delta candles.
It can mark divergences, where price and delta move in opposite directions.
how: Trades from the futures trade stream are split into buys and sells by the side they hit. A bar is strong when its delta is at least 2 times the average absolute delta. The cumulative total resets each session by default.
use: Use it to see whether buying or selling led each bar.
Some traders watch the marked divergences near highs and lows.
Switch to the candle style to follow the session total.
notes: No longer in the Indicators window: futures order flow is now the (L2) tools, part of Pro. A saved chart that still holds this one is switched to Delta (L2) automatically.
Divergence marks describe what already happened; they are not signals.
